snippet.title: A Song Of Sunlight | Steam NEXT FEST Trailer (October 2025)
snippet.description:
The updated trailer for the official demo of "A Song Of Sunlight", available starting October 13th, 2025 at Steam NEXT FEST! 

Head over to the Steam page to try the demo for free right now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2263250/A_Song_Of_Sunlight/
If you enjoyed the demo, please consider leaving a Wishlist to help support it! 

Follow me on twitter for updates and news about the game:
https://x.com/armaculture
